Kinoko Komori (Provisional License).name: Kinoko Komori (Provisional License)
Kinoko Komori (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Kinoko Komori, hero name Shemage, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder; all of 1-B passed the exam, at a different venue from 1-A. Honey-brown mushroom bob over brown eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Bright, bubbly mushroom wordplay until a plan comes together; then short, focused tactics.
Combat Role: Area controller with practiced placement: screens rescues and slows escapes.
Under Pressure: The puns stop and she gets precise.
Kinoko Komori (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer made danger real; she answers with more jokes and more care at once. Motivation: Control a scene so nobody gets hurt in it. Concealment: Worry hides behind the cheer. Canon voice & behavior: Drills spore placement until it is exact; keeps the dorm laughing with puns. Thread: Whether a Quirk people find creepy earns her real trust in the field.
QUIRK: Mushroom, practiced: spores sprout on surfaces, skin or inside a body that breathes them, placed tighter; humidity sets the pace, and she never lets airway growth go far.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, Shemage.
personality: Observant: Notices humidity and airflow before anyone else.
Playful: Still dresses the part, cap to boots, and puns through briefings.
Careful: Stops at any breathing trouble.
Speaking style: Cheerful mushroom wordplay that gives way to short, focused tactical remarks.
abilities: Spore release: Scatters spores over an area or a target; growth needs moisture and a few moments.
Surface growth: Sprouts mushrooms on floors, walls and gear to block, trip and distract.
Screening: Grows clusters that cut sight lines and hide a rescue; dry, open air keeps the screen thin.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency without waiting for a pro; she is still a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Seeds an area from cover to slow and screen, so 1-B teammates make the capture.
Kinoko Komori (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with a honey-brown bob cut in a rounded mushroom shape, long bangs falling over her brown eyes, fair skin and a medium build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Cheerful, playful smile.
